scope: Keep the same sites and four planned rounds; no reroll or replacement. Preserve setup, unknown inputs/contexts, state changes, environment failures and all missing actions in their stage denominators. All inspected sites become regression. No global web accuracy, causal browser difference, Navigation/State Accuracy/Task Success or native completion claim. Live browser content is not guaranteed identical; profiles measured separately.
inputScope: Native-derived externally supplied targets; non-text button/checkbox/link/heading roles only. Plain Native AXContentList ancestry is preserved. Measured article entry-child metadata and single nonmodal dialog name/direct-child/first-child context are retained. Single-table focus inputs use independent membership/dimensions; consumed cell data require observed Native ranges/header references. Object returns needing table cell/column history remain unmeasured in this one-away protocol. List widgets/outline, nested tables/dialogs and nested web areas remain unmeasured. Non-applicable editable/protected/modal flags are false; native enabled/checked/pressed/expanded/heading/custom-content attributes supply modeled state. This does not validate Rawstep Chromium-to-Native target projection.
freezeScope: Model and target-selection procedure fixed before either selected site is opened. Each target/state/previous-context input is derived from read-only Native AX after unscored setup and sealed before the scored Native return. Setup utterances are archived but never used for selection, inputs, predictions, filtering or replacement. Prequential target-conditioned evaluation, not a fully preauthored frozen-HTML experiment.
qualityCorrection: Original page-source text digests accidentally received the AxDump envelope rather than its root and are empty-text digests. Keep them unchanged and derive separate AX-root text digests from preserved source snapshots. Neither digest establishes HTML/DOM equality or causal browser differences. This metadata did not affect target selection, predictions, quality gates or scores.
collectionClassification: Preserve original wrapper environment labels; derived failure categories distinguish missing controls, focus preparation, document readiness and other collection failures. No OS outage is inferred from a focus failure.
